g.text: One day, hundreds of families through the gates, and real branding on posters,
banners, and from the stage. Every gift also joins the pledge below.
No names, no fuss — money that reached people who needed it.
Every rupee we raise this year, after event costs, is split three ways — announced
up front, and tracked on a public ledger anyone can check.
School fees, books and exam costs
Logo on the banners, a mention in our posts, a shout-out on stage.
Give what you make or sell (food, drinks, goods) — we promote your brand in return.
Sponsor a game prize; your brand is named the moment it's won.
Thank you for helping make Vimusement 2026 possible.
· · · tear along here once you say yes · · ·
Tear this strip off the moment you decide to partner with us — no form, no waiting. Fill it in,
photograph it, and send it to Austin on WhatsApp; we'll lock in your tier from there.
